# LifemapR ![](reference/figures/lifemapr-logo.png)

An R package to visualise data on a Lifemap base
(<https://lifemap.cnrs.fr/>)

## Installation

To install the development version of `LifemapR` from GitHub :

``` r

pak::pak("Lifemap-ToL/LifemapR")
```

Once installed, load the package with :

``` r

require("LifemapR")
```

## Usage

Here is a brief introduction on how to use `LifemapR`.

1.  With the `build_Lifemap` function transform your already existing
    data into a format usable by LifemapR functions

``` r

data(eukaryotes_1000)

# Construction of a LifemapR usable dataframe
LM_obj <- LifemapR::build_Lifemap(eukaryotes_1000)
```

After the `build_Lifemap` function the result is a LifemapR format
containing a dataframe :

``` r

full_df <- LM_obj$df
```

2.  Then you can display a map with wanted informations by calling one
    ore more `LifemapR` functions. Note that with the `LifemapR`
    functions, a `shiny` application will be launched

``` r

# Initialise a visualisation for LM_obj
lifemap(LM_obj) +
    # adding a subtree with colored branches
    LifemapR::lm_branches(var_col = "Protein", FUN = mean, col = "PiYG")+
    # adding a set of points
    LifemapR::lm_markers(radius = "GC.", var_fillColor = "Genes", FUN = mean)
```

### How to use during development

Go to the package’s folder

``` r

require(devtools)
devtools::load_all()
```

then you can simply use the package’s functions

# Package index

## All functions

- [`LM_eukaryotes`](LM_eukaryotes.md) : Transformation in a LifemapR
  format of NCBI information for 1000 eukaryotes
- [`add_lm_branches()`](add_lm_branches.md) : Compute the aesthetics for
  a subtree visualisation.
- [`add_lm_markers()`](add_lm_markers.md) : Compute the aesthetics for
  markers visualisation.
- [`add_lm_piecharts()`](add_lm_piecharts.md) : Compute the aesthetics
  for discret values visualisation.
- [`build_Lifemap()`](build_Lifemap.md) : A function to construct a
  LifemapR object, usable by the other functions of the package.
- [`create_matrix()`](create_matrix.md) : Create a dataframe for the
  ancestry.
- [`create_value_range()`](create_value_range.md) : Compute a new scale
  for a value
- [`display_map()`](display_map.md) : Create a Lifemap base.
- [`display_option()`](display_option.md) : Compute the different
  display options.
- [`draw_Lifemap()`](draw_Lifemap.md) : Represent data on a Lifemap
  basemap.
- [`eukaryotes_1000`](eukaryotes_1000.md) : NCBI information for 1000
  eukaryotes
- [`eukaryotes_80`](eukaryotes_80.md) : NCBI information for 80
  eukaryotes
- [`gen_res`](gen_res.md) : Genomic results
- [`is.lifemap_obj()`](is.lifemap_obj.md) : Reports whether x is a
  lifemap_obj object.
- [`is.lm_branches()`](is.lm_branches.md) : Reports whether x is a
  lm_branches object.
- [`is.lm_markers()`](is.lm_markers.md) : Reports whether x is a
  lm_markers object.
- [`is.lm_piecharts()`](is.lm_piecharts.md) : Reports whether x is a
  lm_branches object.
- [`kraken_res`](kraken_res.md) : Kraken results
- [`lifemap()`](lifemap.md) : Initialise a new Lifemap visualisation.
- [`lm_branches()`](lm_branches.md) : Add a "branches" layer to a
  lifemap_obj object.
- [`lm_markers()`](lm_markers.md) : add a "markers" layer to a
  lifemap_obj object.
- [`lm_piecharts()`](lm_piecharts.md) : Add a "piecharts" layer to a
  lifemap_obj object.
- [`make_newick()`](make_newick.md) : Create a newick for the given
  dataset.
- [`pass_infos()`](pass_infos.md) : Infer numerical values to nodes.
- [`pass_infos_discret()`](pass_infos_discret.md) : Infer discret values
  to nodes for lm_piecharts function.
- [`` `+`( ``*`<lifemap_obj>`*`)`](plus-.lifemap_obj.md) : Add a
  graphical element to a tree visualisation.
- [`print(`*`<lifemap_obj>`*`)`](print.lifemap_obj.md) : Method to print
  lifemap_obj objects.
